column6: Holding the card up to explain it; the object is unfamiliar enough that someone has to demonstrate the shape.
Five colours fanned against brick; the decision is which one, and the answer is aesthetic.
Slipped into a leather bag; the whole product argument is that it does not ruin the inside of the bag.
Notebooks, pens and sanitiser on a desk; a new term is the trigger for restocking what gets carried.
White linen on white with no copy; the tile exists to sit in a feed, not to argue.
A hemstitched towel photographed like a specimen; the detail is the only differentiator on offer.
A duvet with the collection name on the label; she is browsing a range, not being persuaded.
Luxurious relaxation stated over a robe and a stretch; the pose is the product being demonstrated.
A fringed throw on white; texture and colour are the entire specification.
One pillowcase, one colour; the catalogue is being served rather than a story told.
A bath mat on white; the tile is doing coverage work inside a large product feed.
The same duvet in the same frame weeks later; nothing about the creative is being iterated.
A folded napkin, unstyled; the buyer here already knows what she is looking for.
Luxury woven into every detail across four crops; the collage is selling a house, not a sheet.
Shoes on dirt with no copy; the silhouette is recognised by the people it is for and nobody else.
Scuffed pair on grass; the wear is the styling and the brand assumes he already knows it.
Seven hundred and four women use instead; the number turns leaving the category into a crowd she can join.
The internet's favorite is a shortcut past comparison; she is buying the consensus, not the oil.
Before and after on real skin with visible texture; the lack of retouching is what makes it usable as evidence.
Five nos stacked down the pack; the entire conventional aisle is being disqualified in one column.
Walking down her own street with it in hand; the ordinariness is what makes the switch look survivable.
Used to preserve dead bodies is the line; the fact does the work no ingredient list could.
